2608.16797.title: UniDot: A Unified Network for Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in Large-scale Recommendation
2608.16797.paper_summary: Industrial recommenders rely on two model families that have evolved largely independently: feature-interaction models over multi-field user/item features, and sequential models over user-behavior histories. Production systems couple them only loosely. To unify the two, we present UniDot, a novel architecture for post-click conversion prediction built from the factorization-machine (FM) point of view: the embedding inner product---which powers collaborative filtering and lets a recommender generalize to unseen user--item pairs---is the same primitive as attention's query dot key scoring, so a single dot-product of tokens can underlie both feature interaction and sequence modeling. UniDot tokenizes non-sequential fields and multi-domain behavioral sequences into one shared token space and stacks a single macro-block in which a token-mixing bus and a sequence-retrieval bus (item tokens cross-attending the histories) run in parallel and exchange state each layer through an MLP-Mixer fusion, while an FM Highway carries explicit per-layer dot-product interactions around the residual stack directly to the classifier. The sequence side is embedded once per forward pass and shared by all consumers, bounding inference latency. Trained with a dual sparse/dense (Adagrad + Muon) optimizer, an auxiliary conversion-delay head, and multi-path mutual learning, UniDot finished as the runner-up on the Industrial track of the TAAC KDD Cup 2026.
2608.16797.paper_summary_zh: 工業推薦系統依賴於兩個獨立演變的模型家族：基於多欄位用戶/項目特徵的特徵互動模型，以及基於用戶行為歷史的序列模型。生產系統僅將它們鬆散地結合在一起。為了統一這兩者，我們提出了UniDot，一種基於因子分解機（FM）觀點的後點擊轉換預測新架構：嵌入內積——這驅動了協同過濾並使推薦系統能夠推廣到未見的用戶-項目對——與注意力的查詢點鍵計分是相同的基本操作，因此單一的標記點積可以支持特徵互動和序列建模。UniDot將非序列欄位和多領域行為序列標記化為一個共享的標記空間，並堆疊一個單一的宏區塊，其中標記混合總線和序列檢索總線（項目標記交叉關注歷史）並行運行，並通過MLP-Mixer融合在每一層交換狀態，而FM高速公路則將每層的明確點積互動直接帶到分類器的殘差堆疊中。序列側在每次前向傳遞中嵌入一次，並由所有消費者共享，從而限制推理延遲。使用雙稀疏/密集（Adagrad + Muon）優化器、輔助轉換延遲頭和多路徑互學習進行訓練，UniDot在2026年TAAC KDD杯的工業賽道中獲得亞軍。
